speaker: Penny
text: What do you mean, no? What's wrong with it? It's exactly the same.

speaker: Leonard
text: Nothing. It's what's wrong with him. Penny, Penny, I think I know what to do. Sheldon, I have some bad news.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Nope. More?

speaker: Leonard
text: Afraid so. You know the cashew chicken I get you on Monday nights?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes, from Sichuan Palace.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sichuan Palace closed two years ago.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Where did my cashew chicken come from?

speaker: Leonard
text: Golden Dragon.

speaker: Sheldon
text: No. Oh, this isn't right. No, our food always comes in Sichuan Palace containers.

speaker: Leonard
text: Yeah, well, before they went out of business, I bought 4,000 containers. I keep them in the trunk of my car.

speaker: Sheldon
text: But. Oh, this changes everything.

speaker: Leonard
text: I thought that might take his mind off the cushion.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What's real? What isn't? How can I know?

speaker: Penny
text: You didn't make that up, right?

speaker: Leonard
text: God, I wish I had.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard? I still don't like this cushion.

speaker: Leonard
text: Yeah, buddy.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay. First of all, Penny, thank you for coming.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, thanks for the shoes.

speaker: Leonard
text: Penny is an amazing shot. I think we have a real chance to win this week. Now, we all run out. Sheldon and I will cut to the left behind these trees. Raj, Howard, and Leslie flank to the right behind the rocks. Then we'll all have a great view as Penny runs out and kills everyone else in sight.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What's the plan?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Just one thing before we start.

speaker: Leonard
text: What is it, Sheldon?

speaker: Penny
text: What the hell?

speaker: Sheldon
text: That was for my cushion.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, Penny was our only hope.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm sorry, Leonard, but revenge is a dish best served cold.

speaker: Penny
text: Screw that.

speaker: Sheldon
text: She can't shoot me. She's dead.

speaker: Leonard
text: He's right. You can't.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, if we're going to descend into anarchy.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, see ya.

speaker: Penny
text: Surrender then, Dennis.
